title: INSTALLATION OF RADIATOR
ocr_text:
INSTALLATION OF RADIATOR

1. INSTALL CONDENSER FAN MOTORS

2. INSTALL RADIATOR
Place the radiator in installed position and install the supports with the bolts.

3. (A/T)
CONNECT A/T COOLER HOSES

4. CONNECT COOLANT RESERVOIR HOSE

5. CONNECT RADIATOR HOSES

6. CONNECT CONDENSER FAN MOTOR CONNECTORS

7. FILL WITH COOLANT
(See page CO-5)

8. START ENGINE AND CHECK FOR LEAKS

9. (A/T)
CHECK AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID LEVEL
(See page AT-18)
